hits.hook: 17 Reviews in 7 Days

patterns: Movie Easter eggs inside a giant game: 5 posts spotting film references in GTA 6 (Dexter's kill room, a Joker parody, a Collateral-style NPC, a Batman parody, a Terminator 2 encounter) drew 4,161,807 views. Counting the sales posts, 7 GTA posts drew 7,091,990, about 36% of all hit views. DiscussingFilm's '$3.79 BILLION first day' post led the board at 2,559,712.

Opening-day cast photos beat box office posts: 14 Hunger Games posts drew 3,117,017 views. FilmUpdates' Mckenna Grace set photos did 1,475,419, the account's best, while the A- CinemaScore posts did 113,406 (DiscussingFilm) and 40,188 (FilmUpdates).

A legacy star coming back to a childhood favorite: two posts on a new Home Alone with Macaulay Culkin returning as Kevin drew 1,310,339 views. DiscussingFilm's version, which included Culkin's single-dad pitch, did 936,591.
Blunt insider quotes travel: Chris Evans' 'I'm just Steve Rogers now' line did 817,779 views with 53,204 likes, and Bassam Tariq's 'life's too short' explanation of leaving Blade did 794,308.

Smaller accounts win with archive footage and plain questions: All The Right Movies' Shining behind-the-scenes clip led its day at 72,994, and its 'rate it out of 10' posts reliably cleared 14K. Cinema Tweets' best was a 'DEVELOPING' Chalamet interview take at 139,818.
narrative_synthesis: GTA 6's launch turned the film feed into an Easter-egg hunt for movie references; Hunger Games opening day ran on cast set photos more than numbers; Home Alone's Culkin return and blunt quotes from Chris Evans and Blade's ex-director carried the rest. Blade's 'casting before a script' story is the best bridge to The Last Check.
window: last 24h (Nov 20 8:20 AM – Nov 21 8:20 AM ET), original posts only
